abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Muradin restores 55 Health per second when he has not taken damage for 4 seconds. When below 40% Health, increased to 111 Health per second.; trait

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.description: Throw a hammer, dealing 110 damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds. quest Basic Attack enemies affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks. Upon hitting 40 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds. reward Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control, Cooldown reduction, Mana restoration
fields.notes: The cooldown reduction and Mana restoration are also gained upon reaching level 10.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Blast nearby enemies for 96 damage and Slow them 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Slow, Slow
fields.notes: 1) Extended by Muradin's unit radius. Does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Attack Slow stacks additively with other effects that can affect the target Hero's Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Dwarf Toss
abilities.description: Leap to target location, dealing 59 damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Defensive damage modifier, Movement: Launch
fields.props: Area of Effect, Armor Clamping, Self-castable

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 Health.; 90; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Avatar also increases Muradin's Basic Attack range by 1.0 while active. Increases both current and maximum Health by given amount. Upon expiration, only maximum Health gets reduced (still capping the current Health at the maximum amount).

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 damage and knocking them aside.; 40; 60; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect (secondary), Knockback, Stationary channel, Stun (primary)
fields.notes: Stun is instant, but primary Knockback and damage are slightly delayed. Interrupting the Ability during this delay puts it on full cooldown. Cast is also interrupted if the target moves farther than 3 range from Muradin. Primary Knockback can launch the unit through Terrain and Structures. Can be cast on Unstoppable enemies, but only deals damage to them.

talents.name: Dwarf Block
talents.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

fields.notes: Can store up to 3 charges of Block. Does not stack with itself or other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

talents.name: Third Wind
talents.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 per second Restoration.
_raw_fields: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 per second Restoration.

talents.name: Give 'em the Axe!
talents.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Muradin's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Sledgehammer
talents.description: Storm Bolt deals 500% damage to non-Heroic enemies. Stormbolt cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Reverberation
talents.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.
_raw_fields: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

talents.name: Thunder Burn
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 damage.

fields.notes: The secondary clap benefits from all talents affecting Thunder Clap. Slows from second explosion do not stack with first's. Subsequent applications refresh the duration.

fields.notes: The counter is reset if the target has not been hit by Muradin's Basic Attacks in the last 5 seconds. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Muradin's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Bronzebeard Rage

fields.notes: Bronzebeard Rage is inactive while mounted. Bronzebeard Rage does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries. Damage from Bronzebeard Rage is unaffected by offensive damage modifiers and lifesteal effects from other sources.

fields.notes: Thunder Strike uses its own base damage value, which is 300% of the original value, causing the percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers. Thunder Strike also has its own base value for Thunder Burn empowered by it.
